violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager has an expired certificate
General food protection. — --Food item was not protected from potential contamination. - Tomatoes in prep cooler had an additional container of tomatoes on top of said tomatoes.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food - Uncooked turkey found on top rolling rack in walk-in cooler. Shelves below turkey had avocados, and other condiments.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. - Items in prep cooler in secondary container found undated. - Open bag of hamburgers found undated in reach-in cooler.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Reach-in freezer needs defrosting.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Reach-in freezer needs defrosting. - Microwave needs cleaning.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not maintained in good repair.
Method, clean, temp, concentration, exposure time, equipment/utensils sanitized (4 pts deducted)
